body:
two of her eras share a wardrobe. same muted-autumn palette, same knitwear, same woods-at-dusk mood — worn back to back, one right after the other.

The Runway lays all twelve out on longlivets.com: twelve eras as twelve closets, from debut's curls and cowboy boots to the orange-sequin showgirl of album twelve. scrub the whole rack end to end and you'll spot the pair that matches — a cream cable-knit cardigan on one, rust plaid and autumnal tones on the other. she named the link herself the day the second one arrived, calling it the first one's "sister record."

name both eras in the replies. no prize but the quiet flex of knowing.

longlivets.com/?lens=fashion&utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=thread-fashion

(pictured: The Runway, as it lives on longlivets.com)

Fresh opener (old one opened 'here's a game...'); reporting reused. Answer is folklore + evermore. Media: /social/library/thread-fashion-intro.png (site-screen, VERIFIED 1080x1350 / ratio 0.800 — IG-publishable; NOT thread-fashion-screen.png, the 780x1688 file that failed 08-23 with code 36003 aspect-ratio). The Runway page is a product surface, the one subject that legitimately earns a screenshot (Taylor-photo standard rung 2). Not in last 10 posted IG media (that file has never posted). Link /?lens=fashion (lens id 'fashion' confirmed). Blocklist-safe (wardrobe/aesthetics). Campaign story-unique, date-suffixed to avoid ever reusing the failed item's value; the 08-25 X fashion sibling can share it (cross-post-copy check enforces >20% divergence).
